methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Train a small masked-canvas value head over DiffusionGemma partial states using final exact-grid outcomes and energy-verifier labels, then expose score_partial_state before rerunning verifier guidance.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .397: build and gate a learned partial-state scorer for DiffusionGemma masked canvases before any new guided-generation headline.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: The paper's latent controller is not a drop-in verifier. If partial targets leak final answers, the rerun becomes circular rather than a learned external guidance moat.
methods_mapped.name: Manta-LM closed-loop diffusion control
methods_mapped.source_read: Language Generation as Optimal Control frames diffusion generation as a stochastic control problem and approximates a closed-loop policy in latent control space.
methods_mapped.v396_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4281 reports diffusiongemma_guidance_moat=false because no learned Carnot verifier can score partial DiffusionGemma token canvases. .397 needs the missing partial-state scorer first.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Log guidance strength, mask entropy, token-change covariance, and trajectory stability for unguided, RFG, EntRGi, and Carnot-scored partial-state arms.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .397: add a masked-diffusion guidance dynamics audit that rejects over-guided partial-state scorers before full-run promotion.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: The theory assumes clean model scores and simplified mixtures; ARC exact-match grids may violate those assumptions, so it is a diagnostic gate rather than a success metric.
methods_mapped.name: Masked discrete diffusion guidance dynamics
methods_mapped.source_read: What Exactly Does Guidance Do in Masked Discrete Diffusion Models derives how classifier-free guidance shapes reverse masked diffusion dynamics and convergence behavior.
methods_mapped.v396_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4281 showed guidance changes selection but the learned arm could not score partial states. .397 should add trajectory-level diagnostics before treating stronger guidance as progress.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Distill held-out selector outcomes and Qwen judge disagreements into a decoding-free representation probe, then compare it against the existing Set-Encoder energy verifier.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .397: train a small representation judge as an efficiency-axis replication of Exp 4284, with exact-grid calibration gates.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: Representation probes can inherit teacher-judge bias and may miss grid-specific exactness. Keep exact target hashes as the final acceptance object.
methods_mapped.name: INSPECTOR Representation-as-a-Judge
methods_mapped.source_read: Representation-as-a-Judge replaces prompted LLM judging with lightweight probes over small-model hidden states, arguing that evaluation needs less semantic capacity than generation.
methods_mapped.v396_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4284 already shows the Carnot energy verifier beats the LLM judge by +0.4423 accuracy at cost_ratio=1.95e-08. .397 should broaden cheap judging without returning to generative judges.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Require candidate selectors to emit or consume proof-tree features on ARC-AGI-2 and RAVEN-style tasks, then test whether the cheap energy verifier transfers across grid and relational substrates.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .397: replace the degenerate ARC-GEN headline with a proof-trace cross-substrate generalization stress gate.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: ABPR depends on executable symbolic hypotheses. Pure grid outputs without stable traces cannot be scored this way without adding a trace extractor.
methods_mapped.name: ABPR trace-guided procedural refinement
methods_mapped.source_read: Abduction-Based Procedural Refinement couples LLM hypotheses with a Prolog meta-interpreter and proof-tree traces, with reported extensions beyond ARC into RAVEN-style relational abstractions.
methods_mapped.v396_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4282's raw ARC-GEN win is adversarial-corrected as degenerate separation, so .397 needs a non-degenerate relational substrate rather than another same-shaped generator pool.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Build a provenance-safe memory of failed selector cases, retrieve only train-side rule summaries, and feed those summaries as frozen context features to the selector.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .397: test retrieval-only selector context on held-out families before reviving online weight updates.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: Experience retrieval can leak target-family structure or stale incorrect rules. Keep target outputs hidden and report frozen context versus random-context controls.
methods_mapped.name: Decocted experience for test-time inference
methods_mapped.source_read: Decocted Experience studies context construction from accumulated experience as a test-time scaling axis for reasoning and agentic tasks without updating model parameters.
methods_mapped.track: online selector improvement without weight mutation
methods_mapped.v396_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4283's online adaptation result is adversarial-flagged for a tautology-style metric match, so .397 should prefer retrieval-only experience context before any selector-head update.
